notes.title: Auto Aim added for gamepad users
notes.content:
1. Auto aim added for gamepad
2. Fixed bug in button binding for Byte
3. Shockwave rounds added to inductor cannon on level 1

notes.title: Added New Weapons, Animations and Particle Effects
notes.content:
1. Added Hysteresis Cannon
2. Added weapon animations
3. Added particle effects for all enemies when destroyed
4. Added shoulder grenade
5. Added ability to back track on levels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
6. Added explosive battery packs
7. Added props (more to come)
8. Fixed bug in pause menu that prevented the player from going to the previous page using the 'Shift' key

notes.title: Feature Update
notes.content:
-Adjustable frame rate added
-Adjustable resolution added
-Enemy HUD added
-Infinite plasma ammunition when playing on difficulty EASY
-Player running speed decreased by 25%

notes.title: Bug Fix and Feature Update
notes.content:
Bug Fix: Mouse & Gamepad sensitivity fixed.
Feature Update: Damage received by player adjusted according to level difficulty.
